title: Hypergraph Extension of the Clique-Partition Number

problemStatement.formal: \text{Define } f_r(H)\ =\ \min\ \{\, |\mathcal{C}| : \mathcal{C}\ \text{partitions the edge set of the } r\text{-uniform hypergraph } H\ \text{into complete sub-hypergraphs} \,\}.
problemStatement.plain: Erdős #1017 concerns partitioning the edges of a graph into cliques and studies $f(n,k) \le \lfloor n^2/4 \rfloor$. This sub-question asks whether the problem extends naturally to $r$-uniform hypergraphs: what is the minimum number of *complete sub-hypergraphs* needed to partition the edges of a $k$-uniform hypergraph, and what is the analogous extremal bound?

currentState.focus: Initial problem understanding. Read problem.md and gather context.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETE: proved always-true direction ccₖ(H)≤cpₖ(H) for all k-uniform hypergraphs (0 sorry, 0 axiom); strict gap remains open as at k=2
builtItems: Erdos1017OQ05.lean: Hypergraph, IsCompleteSub, CompleteCover, CompletePartition, coverNum/partitionNum, coverNum_le_partitionNum (MAIN ccₖ≤cpₖ), trivialPartition, edge_unique_clique keystone, positivity base cases — 12 thms, 8 defs, 0 sorry, 0 axiom, builds 3058 jobs
insights: cc≤cp is purely structural (partition ⟹ cover by forgetting disjointness) and never uses k, so it lifts to every uniformity with no new mathematics
The clique analog for hypergraphs is IsCompleteSub: a vertex set all of whose k-subsets are hyperedges; at k=2 this is an ordinary clique
nextSteps: Exhibit a strict gap ccₖ(H)<cpₖ(H) for a concrete k-uniform hypergraph via edge_unique_clique + a counting identity over k-subsets (k=2 witness is book graph K4-e)
Bridge the k=2 specialization formally to SimpleGraph EdgeCliquePartition of Erdos1017OQ04.lean
